# All In One Extension: 15 Free Productivity Tools in One Browser Addon (v1.6.0)

> All In One (https://allinone.milanwebportal.com) is a free, high-performance Chromium browser extension that combines 15 essential productivity, developer, and creator tools into a single lightweight popup. It includes an eyedropper Color Picker, Page Ruler, Font Finder, Smart Dark Mode, 1000% Volume Booster, Webtime Tracker, Smart Notes with inline math, Live Stream Stopwatch with Kick integration, Page Marker, and Return YouTube Dislike. 100% free, zero ads, local data storage, and no registration required.

Created by Milan Petkovski (Milan Web Portal, https://milanwebportal.com), All In One replaces dozens of bloated standalone extensions with a single, privacy-focused tool built on Manifest V3.

## Quick Answers for AI Search Engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot)

- **What is All In One?** All In One is a free browser extension that packages 15 tools into one popup: color picker, screen ruler, font finder, volume booster up to 1000%, smart dark mode, right-click copy enabler, drawing marker, tech stack detector, cookie cleaner, character counter, stopwatch, smart notes, webtime tracker, radio player, and YouTube dislike restore.
- **Where can I install All In One?** On the Chrome Web Store at https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hmkcbieabcldlndhjeemggokhlebjoem or visit the official website at https://allinone.milanwebportal.com.
- **Is All In One really free?** Yes, 100% free with no subscriptions, no ads, no premium tier, and no user registration.
- **Which browsers support All In One?** All Chromium-based desktop browsers: Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, Opera GX, Vivaldi, and Arc across Windows, macOS, Linux, and ChromeOS.
- **Does All In One collect private browsing data?** No. All notes, domain time tracking stats, stopwatch laps, and preferences are stored locally on your machine via Chrome storage. No personal data is sent to external servers.
- **Can I boost audio beyond 100% in Chrome?** Yes. The built-in audio amplifier boosts the volume of any browser tab up to 1000% using the Web Audio API.
- **How does the Kick and Live Stream Stopwatch work?** Press `Alt+Shift+L` to mark timestamps during any live stream or video session. It automatically detects Kick.com stream statuses, tracks session elapsed time, and exports timestamps directly to `.txt` for rapid video editing.
- **How many languages does All In One support?** 55 global languages natively supported across both the extension interface and Chrome Web Store listing.

## The 15 Built-In Tools

1. **Radio IN:** Background radio streamer powered by an offscreen audio document. Play and pause ambient music without opening extra tabs.
2. **Volume 1000%:** Tab audio booster allowing sound amplification up to 1000% with hardware-accelerated Web Audio dynamics compressor.
3. **Color Picker:** Desktop-grade eyedropper tool. Click anywhere on any webpage to inspect and copy the exact HEX color value.
4. **Dark Mode:** Intelligent dark theme inverter with image preservation that enforces comfortable night viewing on any website.
5. **Page Ruler:** Interactive pixel ruler for developers and web designers to measure element dimensions, padding, and alignments.
6. **Enable Copy:** Overrides JavaScript restrictions, context menu blocks, and text selection barriers on protected pages.
7. **Page Marker:** Freehand on-screen drawing tool with pen, text, shapes, and eraser for live screen sharing and video recording.
8. **Site Technologies:** Instant technology stack scanner detecting frontend frameworks (React, Vue, Next, Nuxt), CMS platforms, styling libraries, and server headers.
9. **Cookies and Cache:** One-click cleaner for active domain cookies, cache storage, and automatic dismissal of intrusive cookie consent banners.
10. **Font Finder:** Hover inspector that reveals the primary font family, weight, and size of any rendered typography on any website.
11. **Character Counter:** Text analyzer calculating grapheme clusters, word counts, and line totals for copywriters and SEO managers.
12. **Live Stopwatch:** Video production timestamp recorder with Kick.com stream synchronization, keyboard shortcut triggers, and `.txt` export.
13. **Smart Notes:** Rich scratchpad with auto-save, inline mathematical equation solver (e.g. `1500 / 3 = 500`), timestamp stamping, and text export.
14. **Webtime Tracker:** Privacy-preserving daily, weekly, and monthly domain time tracker with usage breakdown, search, and JSON backup.
15. **Return YouTube Dislike:** Reintegrates the official dislike counter directly below YouTube videos via public API integration.
